title: SUMMARIZE over the dimension table returns each of its values, sold or not

source.quote: One row is returned for each group.
source.supports: one row per distinct value of the group-by column

source.quote: we always suggest using SUMMARIZE as an equivalent of SELECT DISTINCT in SQL
source.supports: SUMMARIZE without expressions is a distinct

derivation: Product[Color] holds Red, Red, Blue, Green: three distinct values. Sales plays no part.
